scope: Code and temporary synthetic fixtures only. No live packaging, upload, audit/freeze, image/witness/context inspection, or page/record/log mutations.
changes: Prepare the ZIP in an exclusive same-directory temporary file created by mkstemp; close, flush/fsync and CRC-check it before publication.
Calculate size and SHA-256 from the validated temporary ZIP, then publish the final name with exclusive os.link.
Refuse existing archives and preserve another writer's final file if it appears during preparation.
Clean only the tool-owned temporary name; preparation failures cannot occupy the final name. A killed process or failed cleanup may leave only its uniquely named temporary file.
Return successful publication metadata with an optional temporary_cleanup_warning if the committed archive is valid but removing its temporary name fails.
Keep the existing CLI, exclusions, manifest fields, checkpoint/final names and dry-run behavior.

tests.fixture_policy: Each test uses TemporaryDirectory beneath its working directory; only dummy alpha/beta text files and fixture ZIPs are accessed. Fixtures are removed by unittest cleanup. No old or broad test suite was run.

existing_checkpoint14.access: Raw bytes only for SHA-256; archive entries were not opened.

live_page_record_log_state: Not accessed or modified by this fix; parent owns the protected-input snapshot.
